"When Americans work our economy is strong. Our communities prosper and the programs that rely on strong employment like Medicare and Social Security thrive."

Read more about the Limit, Save, Grow Act in my most recent Op-Ed here: https://t.co/G9xYpLRRhd

Social Security and Medicare are integral parts of society – to keep them alive, we need able-bodied adults without dependents off gov handouts & back in the workforce contributing to those programs. Independence comes with employment.

Republicans are working to keep Social Security and Medicare alive through Limit, Save, Grow – any narrative insinuating otherwise is a lie. Democrats won’t even come to the negotiation table.

Read more about the bipartisan group of lawmakers in the House and the Senate joining me in pushing forward a new bill to address the mental health crisis among U.S. veterans
https://t.co/G57lWZxPlk
Veterans need access to residential mental healthcare options through community care so they receive the best and quickest version of assistance possible - even when the VA cannot accommodate.

I’ve found the best way to honor our troops who didn’t make it home is to fight for those who did. 

Every Navy SEAL in Congress has joined me in expanding mental healthcare options for our vets through the Protecting Community Care Act. https://t.co/h3A8YHfgsO

There’s been a lot of noise from Congress this year, but we’ve done a lot of good for Western MT: 
Moved to delist grizzlies 
Introduced the Fill the Lake Act
Expanded mental healthcare for vets
Passed 7 conservative spending bills to root out Biden’s wokeness and poor priorities

Had a productive meeting on Monday with Blackfeet Tribal leadership and Indian Health Services Director, Roslyn Tso, at Tribal HQ. An excellent meeting and a great step forward in ensuring the federal agency works with the Tribe to deliver on their treaty obligations. https://t.co/6B45QkwJqp

On #ForefathersDay, we pay tribute to the trailblazers who fought for freedom and forged the American spirit. Great Montanans like Jeannette Rankin, Thomas Meagher, Chief Joseph Medicine Crow and others whose names we will never know made Montana the Last Best Place.
IVF makes the miracle of parenthood possible for so many families, I unequivocally support continued access to the treatment.

No easier vote then condemning the Biden-created border crisis with H Res 1210. Our public services, healthcare, education & law enforcement are feeling the strain all the way in Kalispell, and the Biden Admin needs to hear the message loud and clear. Shut it down.

Proud to sponsor the HELPER Act to establish a loan program to make homeownership more accessible to K-12 school teachers, first responders & other essential public servants by eliminating some of the barriers for first-time buyers like high down payments & mortgage insurance https://t.co/kg381k6mFz

Today I got to tour RestorEar with the CEO Curtis King. His company makes a non pharmaceutical medical device that uses cold therapy to prevent hearing loss specifically for our military and first responders. He and his company are doing great work here in Gallatin County! Bravo Zulu

Today I welcomed executive leadership from Philips Healthcare to Helena to meet with VA leadership and tour the facility. The purpose of the visit is to better understand rural health delivery for our veterans and how medical devices could innovate to better serve them.  Also have visits to Browning and Kalispell lined up to get a full picture.

The USPS decision to eliminate all expedited mail using air cargo in Montana will severely harm our community. Many Montanans have relied on expedited mail delivery for medication and commerce for decades. I am requesting a full delegation briefing from the USPS on this matter. Our rural way of life depends on a reliable and quick postal service and I urge the USPS to reconsider this decision.

Toured Life Flight facilities in Missoula yesterday. Recently the VA attempted to all-but-eliminate air ambulance coverage for veterans experiencing medical emergencies. I was able to halt that decision, keeping lifesaving resources like Life Flight available to veterans and our communities at large. Thank you to the professionals who make Montana safer!

I met with Veterans Affairs Secretary Collins today to discuss the state of the VA in Montana and his vision for improving rural health delivery. I pressed the need for maintaining affordable access to air ambulance service, reducing wait times, expanding community care, and modernizing records. Our veterans deserve the best and fastest care available, and I believe in Secretary Collins to get the job done.

Excellent meeting today with some of Montana’s top conservation organizations. Over several hours we talked about ideas for migration corridors, landscape health, public access to public lands, forest management and protecting the places we love the most. Everyone in the room might not agree on everything but we agree on the core principle that public lands belong in public hands.

@SuptHedalen nominated me for the #SpeakYourMind Ice Bucket Challenge to raise awareness about mental health and suicide prevention. Montana has one of the highest suicide rates in the nation, and our veteran population is disproportionately affected. This is a crisis we cannot ignore.

Last Congress, I introduced the Protecting Veteran Community Care Act to ensure veterans can access life-saving mental health care in their local communities through the VA. I’ll be reintroducing that legislation in the 119th Congress, but legislation alone isn’t enough.

THE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL 
✅No sale of public lands
✅No tax on tips
✅Lower taxes on social security benefits
✅Renewal of tax cuts for every American, saving the average Montanan $1,400/yr 
✅Work requirements for able-bodied adults receiving Medicaid
✅Kicking illegal immigrants off entitlements
✅Huge investments in border security
✅Ending Biden-era subsidies that put Chinese “green” energy and technology over American-made energy 
✅Unleashing the American economy to grow

I’m a big beautiful YES

1 down, 11 to go. Last night on the appropriations committee we passed the veterans affairs and military construction funding bill.  Wins include:

✅ My bill language protecting vets’ access to air ambulance
✅ Full VA health care & benefits funding, increased by $20m
✅ Base hardening in the Indo-Pacific to counter Chinese aggression
✅ Blocking the VA from sourcing products in China
✅ Protecting vets’ 2A rights

The Big Beautiful Bill PROTECTS Medicaid and SNAP for those who need them. Illegal immigrants and fraudsters shouldn’t get the benefits you work hard and pay for. House and Senate Republicans are fighting to preserve your essential entitlements for years to come.

Work requirements and removing illegal immigrants from Medicaid and SNAP are not cuts, they are savings and needed reforms. The Big Beautiful Bill strengthens these programs by ending abuse and ensuring help goes to those Americans who need these essential services.
